pob.text: In the first year of Cyrus king of Persia[a], so that the word of Yahweh from the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, and he sent a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and also in writing[c][b], saying:

pob.text: Thus says Cyrus king of Persia: Yahweh[a], the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth, and he has appointed me to build a house for him in Jerusalem[b], which is in Judah.

spob.text: This is what Cyrus king of Persia says: “Yahweh, the God of heaven, has given me every kingdom on earth. He has appointed me[a] to build a house[b] for him in Jerusalem, in Judah.”

pob.text: And everyone who remains[a], in any place where he is living, let the men of his place support him with silver and gold, with goods and with livestock[c][b], together with the freewill offering for the house of God that is in Jerusalem.
